ideas.title: Entity-conditioned quantum preparation

observed_problem.statement: Existing heads share positive-to-null errors, without an identified routing cause.

ideas.hypothesis: Explicit entity–word preparation interactions may retain useful compatibility beyond contextualH and native score controls.
